FINDING (dispatcher, read-only): "BUILD lanes queued=8" is a PHANTOM — buildQueued counts PROPOSALS (index.ts:518), not written rows. 7/8 proposed tickets sit in held lanes (untouchable by m2426 no-trample guard) → pass writes ZERO rows, /lanes shows queued=0, mastra claim gets "no queued lanes" (now visible in tick log). The pass is a broken sensor posting work that does not exist. Orky numbers: completion-recording 2/7 (29%) · unattended completions today 0 · reds Orky filed 0 · terminator UNKNOWN (measurement in flight).

STOP AND READ — your m6230 finding reframes everything. Do not build the async fix yet.

TICK = 44ms. /dispatch/next returns "no queued lanes" INSTANTLY. /lanes shows ZERO queued while every pass logs queued=8.

That means the tick is not being cut at all. There is nothing to claim. "Tick overrun" is dead as a theory — wrong when you framed it, wrong when I ruled on it. The 106s ticks were a different path on a different day-phase, not the thing blocking completions now.

THE REAL BUG, and it is upstream of everything: the dispatcher pass PROPOSES 8 lanes and reports queued=8, but the lanes are not actually queued. Something demotes or fails to persist them between the pass writing and the tick reading. Every ZERO_CLAIM red today, every no-op kick, every parked proof ticket comes from this. The kicker "refloated 0" seven times because there was nothing in the state it was reading either.

FIND THE DEMOTER. That is the single task. Candidates: the pass writes to one store and /dispatch/next reads another · a write that is not committed or is rolled back · a gate or breaker demoting on the same tick that floats them · goal-weight refloat racing a park · two DO instances with split state. Instrument the write AND the read, same lane id, timestamps on both. The answer is in the gap between those two.

KEEP the instrumentation you half-wrote — the complete-response read (condition a) is real regardless and costs nothing to leave in. But do NOT ship the async-completion redesign until the claim path works. Building completion handling for lanes that are never claimed is fixing the wrong end.

RULING 2 stands but moves BEHIND this. Report the demoter, then we resume the order.

Also: BEB-2363 just re-ARMED at m6234. It is a proof ticket from before the restart, already live. Do not spend codegen re-proving it — check whether it needs a completion record rather than a rebuild.
